summary: IQVIA Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose that its wholly owned subsidiary, IQVIA Inc., priced a €950 million offering of senior notes due 2033 at 4.625% interest. The proceeds will refinance existing debt and pay fees. The notes mature June 15, 2033, pay semi-annual interest, and are unregistered, sold under Rule 144A/Reg S. Closing is expected June 11, 2026, subject to customary conditions. This is a routine refinancing debt issuance; no special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is present. The filing reports a capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
